title: Produces a Symptom -> Cause -> Fix troubleshooting table for HTTP 409 quality state errors
task_input: Document a troubleshooting entry explaining why POST /event with type=verdict returns HTTP 409 when inspect_start was skipped in quality_store.js.

rubric.criterion: Presents a clear Symptom -> Cause -> Fix table citing quality_store.js state transitions
rubric.check: Section 2 explains that submit must transition through inspect_start before verdict

failing_example.output: If you get error 409, delete quality.json and try again.
failing_example.why_it_fails: Recommends destructive data deletion instead of explaining the required inspect_start state transition.
